text:
maria-fin: Heads up — got invoice INV-HEALTH-2026-04 from HealthGrid for their Private deployment. Platform fee line is EUR 63,450 but our quote/commit was tracked in USD. Can someone confirm FX rate and support-tier mapping? cc @raj-sales @eli-accounting

raj-sales: On it. HealthGrid had an amendment in March adding a region; need to check whether support tier changed to a different SKU. Sales ops will pull the signed amendment.

toby-ops: We added 2 EU nodes on 2026-03-18 which increased reserved capacity. Contract language says customer invoices should be in their billing currency (EUR). However invoice shows conversion to USD using rate 1.10 — that looks higher than our internal rate.

eli-accounting: Quick check: invoice shows EUR 63,450 -> USD 69,795 (rate 1.10). Our reconciliation uses 1.058 for that date, which would be USD 67,126. Delta ~= USD 2,669. Also spot-checked the support surcharge line — it looks like S12 was applied twice (line 4 duplicate) adding another ~USD 1,200.

maria-fin: Thanks. Can billing team confirm the FX source and whether the surcharge duplication is a mapping bug? If it is an error, propose issuing credit for FX variance + surcharge and reissuing corrected invoice. For credits > $2k we need Lucy sign-off. cc @lucy-cfo @billing-bot

billing-bot: Billing system note: INV-HEALTH-2026-04 issued 2026-04-02; currency: EUR; fx_rate_used: 1.10; support_surcharge_code: S12; mapping table: automated mapping v2 applied.

raj-sales: Sales ops: HealthGrid signed amendment 2026-03-15. The amendment language in our doc says support tier = Managed, not Managed-Plus. I suspect mapping v2 misclassified S12 to Managed-Plus. I'll attach the amendment PDF tomorrow.

toby-ops: Ops can confirm the node add and the prorated platform fee portion. I'll produce pro-rata calculation for the March capacity bump.

eli-accounting: If mapping bug, we should void and reissue the invoice. For credits > $2k, Lucy approval required per policy. Tagging @lucy-cfo for approval path.

lucy-cfo: I can approve a one-time credit up to $5k for issues like FX or mapping errors. Finance needs a ticket with the math and proposed reissue timeline before I sign.

maria-fin: OK — I'll open AP ticket and include the delta calc. Preliminary numbers: EUR 63,450 at 1.10 -> USD 69,795; at 1.058 -> USD 67,126; fx delta = USD 2,669. Support surcharge duplicate = USD 1,200. Proposed credit = USD 3,869. Will attach amendment + invoice PDFs once raj posts them.

raj-sales: :thumbsup: I'll send the signed amendment and ask HealthGrid whether they'd prefer a corrected invoice reissue or a credit memo applied to next cycle.

toby-ops: Posted capacity report: /links/internal/report-HEALTHGRID-2026-03 (ops-only). Pro-rate for 12 days in March -> extra platform fee EUR 4,200; that matches line items on invoice, so the only real mismatches are the FX rate and duplicate surcharge.

eli-accounting: AP ticket created #AP-7654. Please set reissue target: corrected invoice reissued by EOM April and credit applied in May if they prefer credit memo. I'll manage GL entries on reissue/credit.

maria-fin: Assigning action items: @samantha-billing to handle reissue/credit, @raj-sales to confirm amendment with customer, @lucy-cfo to approve credit once ticket has docs. Will update thread when HealthGrid responds. Thanks all.

samantha-billing: On it — drafting reissue for 2026-04-10. If HealthGrid prefers credit, we'll issue INV-HEALTH-CRED-2026-04 and apply to May billing. I'll post the draft and internal approval doc here when ready.
